name: cross-review
description: Ask other coding agents, Codex, Claude, or Antigravity, to review an exact Git scope in a persistent conversation per branch, or to research a question side by side with every quote checked against its source.

interface.shortDescription: Code reviews and checked research from other agents.
interface.longDescription: Ask another coding agent to review exact Git scopes with context kept across re-reviews, or put one question to several agents at once and check every quote they cite against its source.
defaultPrompt: Ask Claude to review my current working changes.
Ask Claude to review this branch against main.
Ask Claude to research this question and check its sources.
